annotations.title: Upload a file to your data library from a link

description: Use when the user asks to add a file from a public https link to their own data library (the platform downloads it; links to private or internal addresses are refused). Accepts any file the library takes: a PDF, Word or PowerPoint document, a spreadsheet or CSV, a GeoJSON, shapefile zip, GeoPackage, a GeoTIFF, an image. The dataset is private to the user and counts against their library's quota. Returns its dataset_id; call describe_dataset with it until its state is ready. A document gets its text read, then its layout (and OCR for scanned pages), and can be added to a GeoThought project with geothought_add_documents (uploads: [dataset_id]); geothought_uploads shows those steps.

name.description: The dataset's name (default: the file's name in the link).

url.description: A public https link to the file.
